storage.title: Storage
storage.content: Store at 15-25°C, away from direct sunlight. Shelf life up to 24 months when properly sealed.

certification.title: Certifications & Standards

usageGuidelines.title: Usage Guidelines
items: Ensure surface is clean and dry before application
Do not use on wet or oily surfaces

safetyInfo.title: Safety Information

Keep out of reach of children

acr-001.name: EB 3038
acr-001.title: EB 3038
acr-001.description: Acrylic Adhesive 3038 is designed as a reliable solution for dry lamination applications, offering a milky white appearance, high bonding strength, and excellent weather resistance. It ensures consistent performance, supporting efficient production and durable lamination results.

acr-002.name: EB 5037 MA
acr-002.title: EB 5037 MA
acr-002.description: All acrylic emulsion especially designed for textile applications, mainly used as printing binder.

acr-003.name: EB 727
acr-003.title: EB 727
acr-003.description: Provides excellent rubbing fastness, high gloss and good water resistant.

pvac-001.name: EB 140
pvac-001.title: EB 140
pvac-001.description: Most suitable for bonding all types of wood. It is good for joinery adhesive, bonding Formica sheets and for bonding laminated timber or bare-core construction with high efficiency.

pvac-002.name: EB 140 E
pvac-002.title: EB 140 E
pvac-002.description: Highly suitable for bonding a wide range of wood types. It performs well in joinery applications. It has a low viscosity, making it easy to apply.

pvac-003.name: EB 230 PP
pvac-003.title: EB 230 PP
pvac-003.description: A PVAc product commonly used in the wood industry for furniture applications.

pvac-004.name: EB 435 E
pvac-004.title: EB 435 E
pvac-004.description: Milky white emulsion of Polyvinyl acetate Homopolymer for wood application such as fingerjoint, lumber core or barecore. EB 435 E has good flexibility.

pvac-005.name: EB 460
pvac-005.title: EB 460
pvac-005.description: PVAc with high solid content and a relatively fast drying speed, suitable for applications on medium to hard wood.

pvac-006.name: EB 8429 E
pvac-006.title: EB 8429 E
pvac-006.description: Synthetic emulsion of Modified Polyvinyl Acetate homopolymer for making paper core, paper lamination. This product has good initial tack and fast setting. This type is also easy to apply because it has low viscosity.

pvac-007.name: EB 8435 AK
pvac-007.title: EB 8435 AK
pvac-007.description: Synthetic emulsion of Modified Polyvinyl Acetate homopolymer for making paper core, paper lamination. This product has good initial tack and fast setting.

pvac-008.name: EB 9503
pvac-008.title: EB 9503
pvac-008.description: Milky white emulsion of Polyvinyl acetate Homopolymer that has good flexibility. Designed for general purposes in industry, especially foam to fabric, furniture, paper lamination etc.

pvac-009.name: EB 9110 A
pvac-009.title: EB 9110 A
pvac-009.description: A synthetic glue made from polyvinyl acetate homopolymer. This glue is designed for various purposes in industry, especially attaching foam to fabric, furniture, etc.

pvac-010.name: EB 833 KL
pvac-010.title: EB 833 KL
pvac-010.description: Emulsion of Polyvinyl acetate homopolymer. This product suitable for paper / carton lamination, Paper tube, and etc.

pvac-011.name: EB 832 ET
pvac-011.title: EB 832 ET
pvac-011.description: Milky white synthetic emulsion of Polyvinyl acetate homopolymer for paper applications such as cardbox, paper pallet, honeycomb paper, and elbow paper etc.

pvac-012.name: EB 9504 E
pvac-012.title: EB 9504 E
pvac-012.description: Milky White Synthetic Emulsion of Polyvinyl Acetate Homopolymer. This product designed for various industrial purposes, adhesive, and paper lamination.

sty-001.name: EB 2250
sty-001.title: EB 2250
sty-001.description: High-performance styrene acrylic emulsion designed as a diluent in water-based flexographic inks, particularly for paper and paperboard substrates.

sty-002.name: EB 2251
sty-002.title: EB 2251
sty-002.description: A high-performance styrene-acrylic emulsion designed as a diluent in water-based flexographic inks, particularly for paper and paperboard substrates, with a high Tg and a clear appearance.

sty-003.name: EB 3042 TP
sty-003.title: EB 3042 TP
sty-003.description: Styrene acrylic emulsion especially designed for textile applications, mainly used as printing binder. EB-3042 TP formulation provides excellent rubbing fastness, high gloss and good water resistant.

sty-004.name: EB 5506 B
sty-004.title: EB 5506 B
sty-004.description: A styrene-acrylic product with good brushability, a clear film, and strong adhesion, suitable for metal roof tile applications.

sty-005.name: EB 5502
sty-005.title: EB 5502
sty-005.description: A styrene-acrylic product with excellent film flexibility and strong adhesion, suitable for applications in the foam lamination industry.

sty-006.name: EB 5508
sty-006.title: EB 5508
sty-006.description: Styrene Acrylic Emulsion especially designed for coating formulations, mainly used in industrial and construction application such as metal roofing.

sty-007.name: EB 5512 TI
sty-007.title: EB 5512 TI
sty-007.description: Styrene Acrylic Emulsion especially designed for coating formulations, mainly used as a coating binder.

sty-008.name: EB 765
sty-008.title: EB 765
sty-008.description: Styrena Acrylic product that has excellent compatibility with pigments and extenders, and it has very high binding power for pigments and excellent scrub resistance.

eva-001.name: EB 8102
eva-001.title: EB 8102
eva-001.description: Ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer emulsion, mainly developed for base emulsion of adhesives. This product gives good adhesion for packaging, bookbinding, and bonding for layers of plastic or paper.

eva-002.name: EB 956
eva-002.title: EB 956
eva-002.description: EB 956 is an EVA product with strong adhesion and is commonly used for joint flap applications on laminated or coated paper.

eva-003.name: EB 957
eva-003.title: EB 957
eva-003.description: EB 957 is an EVA product with strong adhesion and is easy to apply through a nozzle for bonding paper to smooth-surface materials.

eva-004.name: EB 8104
eva-004.title: EB 8104
eva-004.description: Vinyl ethylene copolymer emulsion, mainly developed for base emulsion of adhesives. This product gives good adhesion for lamination, papers, woods, PVC sheets.

psa-001.name: EB 660
psa-001.title: EB 660
psa-001.description: EB-660 forms a film with high immediate tack and high peel strength, and can be used in general applications such as labels and bonding paper to smooth-surface materials.

psa-002.name: EB 9334
psa-002.title: EB 9334
psa-002.description: EB-9334 forms a film with high immediate tack, high peel strength, and good cohesion. This product is also easy to apply in adhesive coating processes using a roll.

vnl-001.name: EB 1101 VA
vnl-001.title: EB 1101 VA
vnl-001.description: Polymer vinyl-acrylic emulsion which has good adhesion and water resistance. This product has high solid content and good color acceptance for paint industry.

vnl-002.name: EB 1103 VA
vnl-002.title: EB 1103 VA
vnl-002.description: Polymer vinyl-acrylic emulsion which has good adhesion and water resistance. This product has good elasticity, and good color acceptance for paint industry.
